text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ace, what are you looking at?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, check out this photo of the 
Western-style mansion from the other day. 
I took an amazing shot!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That place everyone's been whispering 
about lately, saying it's creepy. You 
haven't heard? Deep in the woods near the 
park, there's a decaying Western-style 
mansion that looks like a ruin!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's a place like that? Heheh, 
sounds like somewhere Ace would love!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Once I heard nobody went near it 
'cause it was too scary, I suddenly wanted 
to go even more!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
We couldn't exactly go inside, so we just 
took a quick lap around the perimeter. It 
was dark inside the western-style mansion, 
so I couldn't see much.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, on the way home, I felt like 
someone was watching me... So I turned 
around. And then—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Every single window of the mansion was 
lined with dolls! They were all facing 
outside, so it felt like they were 
watching me!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Every single window packed full of dolls? 
That must be quite a sight! —Oh, you have 
photos, right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was looking at that photo, but... 
the crucial doll isn't in it. How strange.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's really cursed? Sounds fun! Take 
me with you next time.
